items.html: And behold, now that all these lights mentioned above have risen upward, and so too in Atik Yomin, the two middle joints of his NH rose and clothed the two upper joints of his NH, and the light there increased greatly, and the Yesod of Atik, situated in the middle between the two first joints of the NH of Atik, has no power to bear so much light. Therefore it split and cracked lengthwise from below upward, and the Hassadim within it are revealed. And then both the Hassadim and the Gevurot within it are in revelation, and there is no difference between them.
